result.summary: The page layout is generally sound, but two visual defects stand out: the top-right account/notification button renders as an empty circle with no icon, and the favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards use inconsistent styling between cards.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right of the header (next to the delivery address) is empty — it shows only a grey circle with a small red notification dot and no icon or label, so its purpose is unclear and it is not identifiable to screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended profile/notification icon inside the circle and add an accessible label (e.g. 'Notifications') so the control is recognizable and announced correctly.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card uses a white circular background with a dark outlined heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/black circular background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment across all restaurant cards (same background fill, icon color, and size) so the control looks consistent regardless of the underlying image.

issues.description: The green promo banner's decorative circle overlay is clipped oddly at the right edge and sits behind the 'Order now' button area, creating an uneven visual balance compared to the rest of the card content.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the decorative shape's position/opacity or clip it cleanly to the card radius so it reads as an intentional background element.
